# Vermilion Routes

> Premier Boutique Tour Operator & Bespoke Nature Expeditions across mainland Ecuador and the Galapagos Islands.

Vermilion Routes provides bespoke nature and comfort expeditions, Galapagos island hopping, boutique cruises, Amazon rainforest lodges, and Avenue of the Volcanoes treks with 24/7 dedicated concierge assistance.

## Key Takeaways
- **Certified Agency:** Licensed boutique tour operator registered with the Ministry of Tourism of Ecuador (RUC 1711992808001).
- **Destinations Covered:** Galapagos Islands (Santa Cruz, Isabela, San Cristobal, Bartolome), Ecuadorian Amazon (Cuyabeno, Yasuni, Napo), Andean Volcanoes (Cotopaxi, Quilotoa, Chimborazo), and UNESCO Colonial Cities (Quito, Cuenca).
- **Service Standard:** Private certified naturalist guides, bespoke tailor-made itineraries, comfort logistics, and 24/7 concierge.
- **Secure Bookings:** Direct encrypted payments via Stripe & major credit cards, guaranteed departure dates, and 100% satisfaction commitment.

## Core Destinations & Expeditions
- [Galapagos Islands](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#destinations): Island hopping, yacht excursions, Santa Cruz, Isabela, San Cristobal, Bartolome, Las Grietas, giant tortoises, marine wildlife.
- [Avenue of the Volcanoes](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#destinations): Cotopaxi National Park, Quilotoa Crater Lagoon, Chimborazo Summit Reserve, Banos Pailon del Diablo Waterfall.
- [Amazon Rainforest](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#destinations): Cuyabeno Wildlife Reserve, Yasuni National Park, Napo River motorized canoe expeditions, indigenous Kichwa communities.
- [Colonial Heritage & Markets](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#destinations): Quito Historic Center (UNESCO), Cuenca Colonial, Otavalo Indigenous Market, Ingapirca Inca Ruins.

## Featured Itineraries
- [Galapagos Islands 4-Day Itinerary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#tours): Santa Cruz highlands, Primicias giant tortoise ranch, Isabela full-day excursion, Tintoreras snorkeling.
- [Galapagos Islands 5-Day Itinerary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#tours): Comprehensive island hopping, Charles Darwin Research Station, Santa Fe and Bartolome excursions.
- [Ecuador: Andes and Amazon Rainforest (7 Days / 6 Nights)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#tours): Historic Quito, Cotopaxi, Quilotoa, Banos waterfalls, Amazon jungle lodge.
- [Ecuador and Galapagos Islands Master Journey (12 Days / 11 Nights)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en#tours): Complete overland expedition and Galapagos archipelago discovery.

## Galapagos Activities Guide (30 activities, 8 languages)
- [All Galapagos activities](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities): Catalog of 30 activities by island, season and type; pick a base tour to see what is included and what can be added.
- [Galapagos private trips hub](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos): Three private expeditions with a naturalist guide, plus combined Ecuador + Galapagos trips.
- [Wild Giant Tortoise Sanctuary (Primicias / El Chato Ranch)](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/giant-tortoises-santa-cruz-highlands): Walk alongside iconic Galapagos giant tortoises in their natural highland sanctuary amidst lush meadows and cloud forests.
- [Las Grietas Volcanic Canyon Snorkeling](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/las-grietas-snorkel-santa-cruz): Swim and snorkel inside a dramatic geological fissure flanked by towering basalt walls with crystal-clear emerald brackish waters.
- [Tintoreras Islet: Shark Crevices & Galapagos Penguin Snorkel](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/tintoreras-islet-isabela): Trek across rugged basalt flows where dozens of white-tip reef sharks rest in crystalline fissures, then snorkel beside playful penguins.
- [Flamingo Lagoon Boardwalk & Arnaldo Tupiza Giant Tortoise Center](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/flamingo-lagoon-isabela): Stroll elevated boardwalks over brackish lagoons observing American flamingos before visiting the breeding center for Isabela giant tortoises.
- [Tortuga Bay Kayaking & Marine Iguana Sanctuary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/tortuga-bay-kayak-santa-cruz): Paddle tranquil lagoon waters framed by mangroves, baby reef sharks, and hundreds of marine iguanas basking on white coral powder sand.
- [La Lobería Beach & Sea Lion Colony Coastal Sanctuary](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/sea-lion-sanctuary-la-loberia-san-cristobal): Crescent-shaped coral sand beach hosting a massive nursery colony of Galapagos sea lions and colossal marine iguanas.
- [Kicker Rock (León Dormido) Shark Snorkel & Circumnavigation](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/kicker-rock-leon-dormido-san-cristobal): San Cristobal’s legendary volcanic obelisk rising 500 feet from the ocean: snorkel through a vertical cleft alongside Galapagos sharks, hammerheads, and eagle rays.
- [North Seymour Frigatebird Colonies & Blue-Footed Booby Mating Dance](https://www.vermilionroutes.com/en/galapagos-activities/blue-footed-boobies-north-seymour): Walk inches away from the world's most vibrant bird courtship colonies: male frigatebirds inflating enormous crimson throat pouches and blue-footed boobies performing high-stepping courtship dances.
